stories.headline: Indian Shares Seen Opening On Muted Note
stories.body: (RTTNews) - Indian shares are seen opening on a cautious note on Friday, even as information technology stocks may rise as disappointing tech earnings fueled a rotation out of the artificial intelligence trade.

stories.headline: Credit issues put damper on profits at SBA specialist Newtek
stories.body: The nation's number-one Small Business Administration lender by number of loans doubled its loan-loss provision in the third quarter, and problem loans spiked. CEO Barry Sloane tabbed inflation and high interest rates as culprits.

stories.headline: Goldman Sachs, JPMorgan and Morgan Stanley are dominating the AI stock boom. Here's their edge
stories.body: Wall Street’s Big Three have generated $52 billion in equity trading revenue this year, capturing about 80% of the market on rising margin lending to hedge funds.
